title: Senior Demand Planner
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Implements tactical and operational planning goals to optimize supply, demand, and inventory strategies for a defined portfolio. Contributes to the execution of new planning processes, product launches, or inventory optimization initiatives that impact service levels, cost efficiency, and overall departmental performance. Manages planning projects or processes, such as supply/demand balancing under constrained capacity, scenario planning, or safety stock optimization. Solves planning problems involving cross-functional variables such as forecast accuracy, lead times, asset utilization, and market fluctuations, often deriving solutions from limited data or historical precedents. Regularly communicates with internal teams across procurement, operations, finance, and commercial, and may coordinate directly with external vendors, contract manufacturers, or key customers. These communications often require translating data-driven insights into actionable plans while balancing risk, cost, and service objectives.

**Job Title: Sr Demand Planner**

**Location:** Coimbatore, India or Pune, India

**Scope of Role:** Global with specific regional and sub-business unit responsibilities assigned based on business need.
  
**Department:** Supply Chain / Demand Planning
  
**Reports To:** Senior Director of Demand Planning

**Position Summary**

The **Sr Demand Planner** role is responsible for the demand planning and S&OP process enablement for assigned market segments, sub-business units, or product categories. This role requires demonstrated success in structured problem solving and directly contributes to continuous improvement efforts by proactively identifying opportunities/risks, defining action plans, and execution efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage planning systems to create forecasts and demand plans in support of the enterprise’s S&OP process

* Support and/or facilitate pre-Demand Review working sessions with S&OP stakeholders

* Define and record the assumptions included within the forecast and/or demand plan

* Perform trend analysis and solicit qualitative feedback from our commercial stakeholders to make informed adjustments to forecasts

* Perform ‘what if’ analysis to project outcomes for various business decisions and scenarios

* Track and measure plan performance, in example: forecast accuracy, forecast bias, forecast value add, and forecast attainment

* Prepare executive level summaries with clear and concise takeaways

* Present Demand Plans, risks & opportunities, and mitigation options to leadership

  

**Core Objectives**

* **Drive enterprise alignment:** Ensure consensus demand plans are documented and agreed to by S&OP leaders with decision rights

* **Enable Delivery Excellence:** Engage with cross functional stakeholders to ensure that the consensus plan is balancing demand with supply, capacity, and operational capability to ensure our internal and external operations teams can execute the consensus plan

* **Mitigate Financial Risk:** Continue to monitor plan performance and highlight gaps as they emerge to enable agile and aligned responses through the S&OP routines and in partnership with the S&OE teams

* **Apply Structured Problem-Solving**: leverage Lean methodologies (i.e. A3, PDCA, 5 Whys/Root Cause Analysis, DMAIC, etc) to identify and eliminate waste in our business processes and foster a culture of continuous improvement

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

* APICS CPIM certification preferred

* Lean/Six Sigma certification preferred

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain, finance, or operations with a focus on working capital optimization.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data/financial modeling

* Experience with supply chain finance programs and advanced planning tools like DA/Blue Yonder, Netstock, Aera, and Anaplan.

* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

description:
**WALK-IN INTERVIEW – EIGENDYNE Pvt Ltd**

**Location:** 1st floor, SF no 172, Pollachi main road, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Coimbatore

Landmark: Latha agencies

**Walk-in Date:** Oct 17th to Oct 18th  
**Time:** 9.30 am to 5 pm  
**Venue:** 1st floor, SF no 172, Pollachi main road, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Coimbatore. Landmark: Latha agencies

**Contact: i**nfo@eigen-dyne.com

**ABOUT EIGENDYNE**

EigenDyne is a Tamil Nadu-based deep-tech robotics startup building adaptive, vision-driven robotic scanning systems for manufacturing and automotive OEM customers. Our platform combines classical computer vision, precision motion, and fleet-level software to automate inspection and quality workflows on the factory floor. We are recognized under the Startup India (Deep Tech) initiative.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Robotics Engineer to design, develop, and deploy robotic arm-based automation solutions. You will own the ROS2 software stack for our robotic arm platforms, from simulation in Gazebo through to real-world deployment on the shop floor with industrial customers. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role suited to an engineer who enjoys working across the full stack — motion planning, integration, and field deployment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain ROS2-based software for robotic arm (cobot) platforms used in variousapplications
* Build and validate simulation environments in Gazebo for motion planning, path validation, and workcell layout before physical deployment
* Integrate robotic arms with vision sensors, end-effectors, and scanning payloads
* Develop and tune motion planning (e.g., MoveIt2)
* Work closely with the computer vision and controls teams to integrate scanning algorithms with arm motion
* Debug and optimize system performance across simulation and real hardware, closing the sim-to-real gap
* Support on-site commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of deployed robotic systems at customer/OEM facilities
* Contribute to system architecture decisions, code reviews, and documentation for the robotics software stack

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2-6 years of hands-on experience in robotics software development
* Strong working experience with ROS2 (nodes, topics, services, actions, launch/parameter systems)
* Practical experience with Gazebo (or equivalent) for robot simulation and testing
* Experience programming, integrating, or deploying robotic arms/cobots (e.g., Doosan, UR, ABB, Fanuc, or similar)
* Proficiency in C++ and Python for robotics application development
* Understanding of robot kinematics, motion planning, and control (MoveIt2 or equivalent frameworks)
* Experience integrating sensors (cameras, depth/LiDAR sensors) with robotic systems
* Comfortable working in Linux/Ubuntu development environments and using Git for version control
* Willingness to travel for on-site deployment and support at customer/OEM facilities as needed

**PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE**

* Experience with industrial cobots specifically in manufacturing/automotive inspection use cases
* Familiarity with point cloud processing and classical computer vision techniques
* Exposure to fleet management or multi-robot orchestration systems
* Experience with CI/CD or automated testing for robotics software
* Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced product development environment

**EDUCATION**

B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.

Interested candidates can send their updated resume to i**nfo@eigen-dyne.com**
